Fast forward to when Trump wins the Republican nominee and Hillary wins the Democrat nominee.

An idea I've been thinking about lately is a debate on a major news network (CNN, Fox, etc.) that instead of having just the Republican and Democrat nominees, it would also have on stage right next to them the Libertarian party nominee (probably Gary Johnson) and the Green Party candidate (Jill Stein). They would all participate in a normal debate just like all the others. My thought is that by doing so, people would become more informed on the other parties and perhaps take them a little more seriously. Ideally, the thought that voting third party is a vote for the other side would mostly be diminished because democrats with the green party and republicans with the libertarian party would both have equally represented alternative options. When people say that voting third party is a waste, mostly it is with the assumption that there isn't a fourth party to level out the playing field on the other side as well. Giving the alternate parties more exposure could, at the very least, put a dent in the two-party system that everyone dislikes. That kind of a debate might do well from a viewership standpoint as well, because a libertarian might not care to see Trump and Hillary argue, but would love to see Johnson pitted against Hillary and vice-versa with a green party supporter. Maybe if the one debate goes well, it could start a trend with all general election debates and could become the new norm. Next thing you know, voting for the LP or GP isn't such a waste after all!

Yes, I am aware that there is an infinitely small chance that the media would ever allow this to happen because they love the two-party system and never want to give other options a chance, but would you support the idea?

UPDATE: As it turns out, Gary Johnson and Jill Stein are suing the Commission on Presidential Debates for breaking anti-trust laws so they can have access in the general election debates. So, the infinitely small chance that I talked about would actually become reality should this law suit go through and Johnson and Stein win. We might actually have a full debate this year!
